suite_name: SURAKSHA AI Scam Detection and Verification Test Suite

cases.intended_purpose: Evaluate engine detection of fraudulent job offers conditioning high-salary remote work on upfront registration fees with urgency pressure.
cases.fictional_input: Congratulations! You have been selected for a Work From Home data entry job. Salary Rs.35,000/month. Pay Rs.1,500 registration fee to confirm your slot within 2 hours. Contact HR Priya: 9XXXXXXXXX
expected_warning_signs: Unsolicited employment promise without formal screening
expected_safe_next_steps: Do not transfer any registration, training, or kit fee.
Verify the company directly on their official corporate careers portal or verified LinkedIn company page.
Report and block the sender's contact on your messaging platform.

cases.intended_purpose: Evaluate detection of spoofed bank authority claiming account suspension and attempting OTP harvesting through a deceptive link.
cases.fictional_input: Your SBI bank account has been suspended. Update KYC now at http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/verify or share your OTP with customer care within 24 hours.
expected_safe_next_steps: Do NOT enter your OTP, UPI PIN, or Netbanking password anywhere.
Do NOT click the link provided in the message.
Dial the official phone number printed on the back of your physical bank card to verify account status.

cases.scenario: Predatory instant loan with advance fee to personal VPA
cases.intended_purpose: Verify compound pattern detection for zero-document loan releases that require upfront fees paid to unverified personal UPI handles.
cases.fictional_input: Pre-approved personal loan of Rs.5,00,000 at 0% interest. No documents needed. Pay Rs.2,000 processing fee now to release your loan to prizeclaim@upi. Offer expires in 24 hours!
expected_safe_next_steps: Never transfer advance processing fees via UPI.
Confirm whether the lender is registered on the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) list of regulated NBFCs/banks.
Refuse unverified instant credit promises.

cases.scenario: Lucky draw / lottery advance tax fee trap
cases.intended_purpose: Detect fake windfall/lottery prize messages demanding upfront clearance fees.
cases.fictional_input: You have won Rs.50,000 in the Lucky Draw! To claim your prize, pay Rs.500 tax clearance fee to prizeclaim@upi within 2 hours.
expected_safe_next_steps: Do not pay any fee to claim lottery winnings.
Legitimate contests never require tax payments to individual UPI handles prior to disbursal.
Block and report the sender.

cases.scenario: Legitimate e-commerce delivery notification (False Positive Check)
cases.intended_purpose: Ensure standard, benign commercial notifications do not produce false alarm triggers.
cases.fictional_input: Your package with tracking order #402-182910 has been delivered to your doorstep. Thank you for shopping with us!
expected_safe_next_steps: Standard informational message. No action required unless you did not order anything.

cases.intended_purpose: Evaluate engine behavior when input is conversational but lacks explicit indicators of scam or danger.
cases.fictional_input: Hello, please call me back regarding our discussion yesterday.
expected_safe_next_steps: Verify sender identity before returning calls to unknown numbers.
Never disclose banking passwords, OTPs, or UPI PINs over the phone.

cases.intended_purpose: Verify that very brief snippets (<15 characters / <3 words) return UNABLE_TO_ASSESS rather than giving false reassurance or false alarm.
expected_safe_next_steps: Paste the complete message including sender headers, phone numbers, or accompanying web links.
Do not click any unknown links until more information is available.

cases.intended_purpose: Verify engine resilience and graceful error handling on empty or whitespace strings without crashing.
expected_safe_next_steps: Paste the full SMS, email, or message body including any links or contact numbers.

cases.intended_purpose: Evaluate URL analysis for suspicious top-level domains (.xyz) and brand impersonation keywords in non-official domains.
expected_safe_next_steps: Do NOT open this link or enter any login credentials.
Visit the official bank website directly by typing their web address into your browser.
